decisions.reason: Transactional email builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise and was featured on the home page, so it is strategically central and the firm can interpret and improve it with its own R&D.
Managed capture extends the firm's electronic document workflow know-how, has a dedicated page and a named customer reference, giving the firm clear feedback to learn from and refine the service.
Email-to-fax conversion relies on the firm's long-standing fax and messaging infrastructure, so it is cheap to maintain and serves regulated customers, though fax is a declining channel.
The delivery optimization feature is embedded in the established fax service and needs little separate investment, although it could be folded into the base offer as fax demand shrinks.

Sandbox threat protection strengthens the firm's core email security portfolio in a growing threat landscape, and in-house R&D lets it absorb security knowledge, unlike the multi-engine scanning that was replaced.
